 Chelsea v Man United LIVE: Michael Carrick under pressure again as team fall apart after Lisandro Martinez red card
 Carrick appeared on the brink of the sack at the start of the week but has been given another game to try and end Manchester United’s winless run 
 Miguel Delaney at Stamford Bridge , Michael Jones & Jamie Braidwood Saturday 31 October 2026 14:22 GMT

 Alonso says table 'doesn't matter' as Chelsea prepare to face Man Utd Michael Carrick is once again fighting for his Manchester United future as his side travel to Chelsea in the Premier League . 
 Bruno Fernandes was recalled by Carrick and started as captain in a chaotic first half. Fernandes blazed a golden chance over the bar on the volley while Amad Diallo also missed a clear opening after Wesley Fofana slipped. Estevao and Matheus Cunha both had opening goals ruled out for offside, while Pedro Neto shot wide following a Harry Maguire mistake. 
 Carrick appeared on the brink following the 3-0 home defeat to Bournemouth last week but survived crisis talks with the United hierarchy and remains in charge for the trip to Stamford Bridge , despite the club sounding out Eddie Howe and Julian Nagelsmann as his potential replacement. 
 There is some pressure on Chelsea boss Xabi Alonso , too, following the home defeat to rivals Tottenham last weekend and their exit from the Carabao Cup against Liverpool in midweek. Joao Pedro remains sidelined due to injury, although Cole Palmer returns from suspension and Estevao is handed his first start of the season.

 Chelsea 2-0 Man Utd
 90+3 mins: Zirkzee wins United a corner after decent defending from Colwill. 
 Fernandes jogs over to take it. 
 He lofts a high cross into the middle and the ball is knocked to Mbuemo on the edge of the box. 
 Mbeumo smashes the ball and drills it onto the underside of the crossbar!
 Mike Jones 31 October 2026 14:22 Chelsea 2-0 Man Utd
 90 mins: 10 minutes of added time, 10!
 Where has that come from? 
 Mike Jones 31 October 2026 14:20 Chelsea 2-0 Man Utd
 87 mins: Save! 
 Estevao, who has been starved of gametime recently, is desperate for a goal today. 
 He’s had two disallowed and his last action of the game is to blaze a shot at goal and force a leaping stop out of Lammens. 
 The winger is then taken off in a triple change for Chelsea. 
 Malo Gusto, Valentin Barco and Danny Welbeck come on to replace Moises Caicedo, Pedro Neto and Estevao 
 Estevao receives the warmest applause as he departs and he is given a big hug by Xabi Alonso too. 
 Mike Jones 31 October 2026 14:17 Chelsea 2-0 Man Utd
 84 mins: Zirkzee fires a shot from range and sends it straight into the arms of Penders. 
 That’s United’s first attempt of the second half. It’s been tough going for them since the break. 
 Mike Jones 31 October 2026 14:13 Chelsea 2-0 Man Utd
 82 mins: Around 10 minutes of this match to play if you included added time. 
 Man Utd cannot concede again. 
 They need to hold Chelsea at bay and try, somehow, to get themselves a goal. 
 The United fans haven’t stopped chanting for their team and their manager. 
 Mike Jones 31 October 2026 14:12 Chelsea 2-0 Man Utd
 79 mins: Amad is taken off and Zirkzee comes on. 
 Chelsea are pushing for more goals and rightly so. 
 They have Man Utd at their mercy and can use the opportunity to further the cause of their own boss Xabi Alonso. 
 ( Getty ) Mike Jones 31 October 2026 14:08 Chelsea 2-0 Man Utd
 76 mins: Amad Diallo remains on the deck after a decent run forward. 
 He’s clutching his left calf and may have an issue. It’s not the first time he’s gestured to that leg today. 
 Carrick has Joshua Zirkzee primed and ready to come on. 
 These next 15 minutes or so are crucial for Carrick and United. They need to show some fight for the manager here. 
 Mike Jones 31 October 2026 14:06 DISALLOWED! Chelsea 2-0 Man Utd
 73 mins: VAR are checking the goal for offside. 
 It’s the tightest call so far but the winger is just ahead of Maguire.
 It’s a matter of inches but the goal is ruled out. 
 Mike Jones 31 October 2026 14:03 GOAL! Chelsea 3-0 Man Utd (Estevao, 71')
 Shocker. 
 Fernandes gives the ball away and United are caught on the break. The weight of the pass from Palmer is pinpoint and sends the winger into the box. 
 Estevao then blasts his effort past Lammens and United concede a third goal. 
 Mike Jones 31 October 2026 14:01 Chelsea 2-0 Man Utd
 69 mins: Oh close! 
 Chelsea almost have a third as Estevao is played into the right side of the box. 
 He curls a decent pass over to the back post and Palmer is there for a tap in...
 ... but Maguire flings out a leg and touches it just past the Chelsea talisman.
